caveats: All metrics recomputed from rounded native task matrices; AAA and FAA are task-macro percentages; LA is diagonal mean. Forgetting uses max over every stage from initial learning through final stage (inclusive), so improved tasks have zero, not negative, forgetting; excludes newest task and divides by9.
One seed, exploratory inference; natural SGD final update norms are not matched, so differences include both direction and amplitude.
Historical controls compute discarded g1_minus instead of discarded g3; exact state/RNG replay makes their intended selected-direction SGD semantics comparable, but probe-budget details differ.
Trace medians compare learned trajectories, not simultaneous counterfactual directions at a common parameter state; first common-state step may be separately inspected.
Radius is normalized trainable-parameter distance; actual unscaled BA+FC effective displacement is measured separately.
No new experiments launched by this analysis.

decomposition_at_common_gradient_state.definitions: d10=g1−g0=alpha10*g0+p10; d20=g2−g0=alpha20*g0+p20; alpha=alpha10+alpha20; v=p10+p20; projections use one global g0 vector and denominator ||g0||²+1e−12
decomposition_at_common_gradient_state.qualifier: Algebra holds for common gradient vectors up to floating-point rounding; gradients and alpha along separate evolving training trajectories differ.

conclusions: Best of this six-run campaign is positive-probe g1+g2 at r=1: AAA68.6048404762/FAA54.722; no g3 contribution to final U.
At r=.25, one extra g0 term has almost zero observed AAA/FAA gain, while r=1 gains3.829425397 AAA and7.849 FAA; the larger-radius benefit depends on final combination.

Keeping parallel residuals improves AAA at both radii (.91069/2.48154), but at r=1 removing them slightly improves FAA by .279 and reduces forgetting1.8933; parallel contribution is not universally helpful.
Perpendicular residuals alone added to g0 improve AAA and FAA over g0 at both radii; against g1 they improve both at r=.25, but r=1 has lower AAA (.93987) and higher FAA (2.574).

Sum-minus-g0 is almost collinear with g2 on its own trajectories (median cosine .999278/.999148). This small local directional change nevertheless changes nonlinear CL trajectories, and cannot by itself prove robustness or second-order mechanism.
Trace median norm ratios U/g2 for sum/perp/sum-minus-g0 are1.664/.838/1.056 at r=.25 and1.378/.919/1.021 at r=1; natural-step outcomes contain update magnitude as well as direction effects.
Perpendicular second residual norm is typically7.239x/18.282x the first at r=.25/r=1 on perpendicular-run trajectories; this is descriptive gradient geometry, not causal proof.

The r=1 sum beats sum-minus-g0 at all ten stage means and all ten final-task entries; first five stage differences≤.992 and largest stage7 gap10.177, with final old-nine mean+6.798 and newest task+17.310.
Recommended optional next causal check: compare sum vs sum-minus-g0 at r=1 after matching measured effective BA+FC update norm, and replicate seeds. This analysis launches nothing.

calculation_correction.cause: Initial independent calculator mistakenly excluded the final stage from the max; this allowed negative forgetting for tasks improved in the final stage, conflicting with official validator contract. Corrected to include final stage. AAA/FAA/LA/BWT unchanged.
